nodes.label: Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V. Logo
nodes.description: Official logo of Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V. (Fire Department District Association Freising). Three elements: (1) Bavarian/Freising district coat of arms with blue-and-white diamond pattern upper half and crowned figure with white rose on red lower half; (2) Red fire department shield with flame, steering wheel/helm, and crossed axes — standard German fire service insignia; (3) Organization name in light italic sans-serif: 'Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V.' on two lines. Primary colors: red, white, yellow/gold, blue.

nodes.label: Freising District Coat of Arms
nodes.description: Coat of arms of Landkreis Freising: upper half Bavarian blue-and-white lozenge pattern; lower half crowned figure with white rose on red.

nodes.label: German Fire Department Shield Emblem
nodes.description: Red shield with white fire department symbols: flame at top, helm/wheel in center, crossed axes. Standard Bavarian fire service insignia.
